title: helianthus buphthalmoides
intro: Helianthus buphthalmoides, commonly known as the false sunflower, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues. Helianthus buphthalmoides is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and may help to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit wound-healing properties.
